GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. moved up Wide turn 3 lengths. just battled in Straight # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Passing the 900m got its head up when racing near heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 5th 3 lengths. over raced early. got to outside turn 3 lengths. weakened # Ordinary Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Change of tactics: to be ridden quieter, settled worse than mid-field. Raced keenly in the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok worked to lead. shared lead turn under pressure. dropped out # poor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race veterinary examination revealed the gelding to be lame (1/5) in the near foreleg. Trainer was told a veterinary clearance is required before being permitted to barrier trial or race again. Veterinary clearance since received.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Debut for stable. jumped awkwardly & bumped @ start. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field Two Wide (4L from lead). Stayed Mid Field Two Wide midrace & 3 Wide @ 700m. Pushed to quicken @ 550m & pressured Six Wide (6L from lead) on home turn. dropped right out in straight. Rider - struggled on heavy/vetted clear. # Poor effort.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and bumped.  When questioned regarding the performance, rider stated that gelding never travelled on the heavy track conditions. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. got to outside turn 3 lengths. ran on well. battled late # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping shifted in and bumped rnr. Approaching the 200m became unbalanced after shifting in slightly making contact with other rnr. Approaching the winning post became unbalanced after making contact with rnr which shifted out slightly and other rnr which shifted in slightly.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 5th 4 lengths. got to outside turn 2 lengths. battled away # Every Chance
jumped ok. Settled Down 3rd rail 5 Lengths good pace. Straightened Up 3rd under riding 3 Wide into clear. bit green Under Pressure and couldn't finish off to line. # green/faded
